text:
Type: high-gloss desk with two drawers
Use: working at a laptop, studying, a dressing table; home office, bedroom, living room
Style: modern, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: high-gloss white lacquered board, white steel legs
Colors: glossy bright white
Shape: long narrow shallow top, two wide flush drawers under the top, slim rectangular U-shaped metal legs at each end, sleek, light and open
Feel: sleek, bright, clean, crisp
Goes with: grey or black chairs, chrome, white walls, colorful accents; modern, minimalist or contemporary rooms
